structure: NJSLS-SS 2020 grade-band file for K-2 (end of grade 2). Front matter (intro, mission/vision, framework, practices, structure/coding, essential questions, NJ statutes, references) pp.1-12. Then 'By End of Grade 2 / Disciplinary Concepts' tables per strand (Civics; Geography; Economics; History) with columns Disciplinary Concept | Description | Core Ideas (cell C1/C2/C3). Then Standard 6.1 U.S. History: America in the World by the End of Grade 2 and Standard 6.3 Active Citizenship in the 21st Century by the End of Grade 2, with tables Core Idea | Performance Expectations; PE codes 6.<std>.<grade 2>.<Strand><Concept>.<n> (e.g. 6.1.2.CivicsPI.1). All grade-level content is the K-2 band (labeled K-2). No courses. Description column cells of the disciplinary concept tables labeled examples (narrative); concept names and core ideas labeled standards.
